remediationPlans.rootCause: TaskController exposes the JPA-managed Task entity directly as request/response body across all REST endpoints, leaking persistence details (including nested @Entity relations and enums) to API consumers and coupling the web layer to the persistence model.
remediationPlans.remediationIntent: Introduce a persistence-decoupled TaskDTO used exclusively at the controller boundary for request/response payloads, and add explicit mapping logic between Task entity and TaskDTO so the entity never crosses the API layer.
requiredChanges: Create TaskDTO as a plain POJO (no JPA annotations, no import of com.pfe.devsecops.model.Task or User) with fields: Long id, String title, String description, String status, Integer priority, LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt, Long userId.

Represent the persistent Task.TaskStatus enum in TaskDTO as a plain String field named 'status' (consistent with project convention of exposing enums as strings at API boundaries), preserving all four values TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED.

Add mapping methods (e.g., static TaskDTO fromEntity(Task task) and Task toEntity(TaskDTO dto) or equivalent conversion helpers) either in TaskService or a dedicated mapper class, converting task.getStatus().name() to DTO string and TaskStatus.valueOf(dto.getStatus()) back to entity, and mapping task.getUser() to userId (null-safe) without exposing the User entity.

Update TaskController endpoints (getAllTasks, getTaskById, createTask, updateTask, processTask path build) to accept and return TaskDTO instead of Task, invoking the new mapping methods around existing TaskService calls.
Ensure createTask/updateTask convert the incoming TaskDTO to a Task entity before calling taskService.createTask/updateTask, and convert the returned Task back to TaskDTO for the response.
Preserve existing IDOR comment and behavior unchanged aside from the type substitution; do not alter authorization logic in this change.
forbiddenChanges: Do not have TaskDTO import or reference com.pfe.devsecops.model.Task, com.pfe.devsecops.model.User, or Task.TaskStatus (the nested persistence enum).
Do not add JPA/persistence annotations to TaskDTO.
Do not remove or weaken the IDOR-related comment or any existing security-relevant logic.
Do not change SQL query construction in TaskService.searchTasksByTitle.
Do not alter unrelated endpoints' business logic (validateAdmin, processTaskWorkflow internals).
Do not suppress or disable the Sonar rule via comments or configuration.
expectedBehaviorPreserved: All CRUD endpoints continue to perform the same operations against TaskService with identical semantics.
TaskStatus values TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, CANCELLED remain fully representable and round-trip correctly through the DTO string field.
Existing NPE risk, IDOR, and SQL injection comments/behavior remain unchanged (out of scope for this fix).
API responses continue to return JSON with the same conceptual task data (id, title, description, status, priority, timestamps, and owning user id).

validationStrategy.scanner: re-run SonarQube java:S4684 on TaskController.java to confirm no persistent entity is used as a controller parameter or return type
